mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.apply_id AS applyId, a.apply_no AS applyNo, a.apply_dept_id AS applyDeptId, d.department_name AS applyDeptName, a.apply_user_id AS applyUserId, e1.actual_name AS applyUserName, a.apply_time AS applyTime, a.apply_status AS applyStatus, a.approve_user_id AS approveUserId, e2.actual_name AS approveUserName, a.approve_time AS approveTime, a.approve_remark AS approveRemark, a.create_time AS createTime, a.remark FROM t_spd_apply a LEFT JOIN t_department d ON a.apply_dept_id = d.department_id LEFT JOIN t_employee e1 ON a.apply_user_id = e1.employee_id LEFT JOIN t_employee e2 ON a.approve_user_id = e2.employee_id WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.del_flag = #{delFlag}
